tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Ubiquiti airMAX PowerBeam 5AC 620 with 29 dBi Dish 450+ Mbps Wireless Radio Link


The Ubiquiti airMAX PowerBeam 5AC 620 (PBE-5AC-620) is a high-gain, long-range Point-to-Point (PTP) wireless radio system built for outdoor wireless backhaul and bridging. Featuring an integrated 620 mm parabolic reflector with a powerful 29 dBi antenna gain, this device delivers stable and high-throughput performance over 30+ kilometers, even in noisy RF environments.

Built on Ubiquiti’s airMAX® ac technology, the PowerBeam 5AC 620 supports 802.11ac, airMAX TDMA protocol, and airOS 8, offering enhanced speed, scalability, and intuitive management. The device is designed for network operators, enterprises, and surveillance applications that demand dependable high-speed wireless connectivity.


Key Features:

  • Frequency: 5.1 – 5.9 GHz (varies by region)

  • Antenna Gain: 29 dBi (620 mm reflector)

  • Wireless Standard: 802.11ac (airMAX ac)

  • Throughput: Up to 450+ Mbps real TCP/IP

  • Range: Over 30 km (line-of-sight)

  • Powerful RF performance with dedicated spectral analysis

  • Robust outdoor IP65-rated enclosure

  • Management: airOS 8 with airView® and airMagic®


Link Distance:

  • Max Range: 30+ km (clear LOS with precise alignment)

  • Typical PTP Link: 10–25 km with excellent signal stability


Ideal Use Cases:

  • Rural backhaul links

  • Long-range wireless bridges

  • CCTV & remote site video transmission

  • Fiber replacement in hard-to-reach areas

  • ISP-to-ISP wireless backbone
